name: Glass Cannon
rule: Team damage +25%; damage taken +35%.

name: Elite Hunt
rule: An additional boss spawns two levels above the stage.

name: Resource Drought
rule: Gold income is halved and shop prices are increased by 50%.

name: Speed Clear
rule: Complete the Invasion floor within 150 seconds.

name: Flawless
rule: Complete the floor without any player dying.

name: Purge Protocol
rule: Enemy count is increased by 35% for this floor.

name: Double Wave
rule: Enemy count is increased by 50% for the next four waves.

name: Boss Rush
rule: An additional boss appears in waves two and four of the section.

name: No Respawn
rule: Players cannot respawn during the next four waves.

name: Tight Deadline
rule: The Extraction time limit is reduced by 30%.

name: Black Box
rule: Recover the marked objective by remaining at it for 3 seconds.

name: Overrun
rule: Evacuation reinforcement size and active cap are doubled.

name: Attrition
rule: Health, armor and Barrier recovery are reduced by 50%.

name: Overclocked Hostiles
rule: Enemies move 15% faster and deal 25% more damage.

name: Sealed Supplies
rule: Shops and stage supplies are disabled for the current floor.

name: Elite Guard
rule: Each objective gains one elite guard a level above it; all guards must be killed.

name: Fortification Tax
rule: Building and repair costs are increased by 75% for the next four waves.

name: Rising Tide
rule: Enemy count rises by 15%, 30%, 45% and 60%; final-wave enemies gain 25% health.

name: Heavy Cargo
rule: Carry spawned cargo into extraction; the carrier moves 20% slower and may drop it.

name: Locked Route
rule: Activate two additional radar-marked switches before the exit opens.
